Canonical replacement for legacy/source com from Latin cum/com-. Chosen as kun to avoid collision with canonical question word kom = HOW. Also canonical invariant free comitative relator in kun + noun phrase; the former comitative suffix -ko is retired.
Canonical replacement for legacy cred.
Canonical replacement for legacy/source cur from Latin cura. Chosen as kurar to avoid collision with the former WHY question word; WHY is now ker.
Canonical replacement for legacy dec.
Canonical verbal root replacing legacy dict; regular participial/resultative dikit.
Canonical replacement for legacy direct.

Canonical replacement for legacy doc and former dots. Source Latin docere means teach; Latin doctor is its agent noun. The k adaptation preserves the doc-/doct-/doctor family transparently under the canonical alphabet, giving regular dok + -or -> dokor (teacher).
Canonical replacement for legacy fac.
Canonical replacement for legacy loc.
Canonical replacement for legacy spec.

Canonical human/person root replacing earlier om. Optional referential specificity gives umano (male person/man) and umane (female person/woman); explicit plural is wi uman. Abstract humanity is regularly umanitat via -itat.
Keep spelling major. Under the current alphabet j is the glide /j/, so canonical pronunciation is /ma.jor/, not legacy /madzh-or/.
Canonical replacement for legacy ekual. With current w=/w/, canonical pronunciation is /e.kwal/.
Canonical WH-word HOW. Retained after moving Latin cum/com- lexical root to kun.
Canonical WH-word WHY, replacing legacy kur to avoid collision with the care/cure lexical family.
Canonical invariant free instrumental/perlative relator. Former suffix -per is retired.

entries.meaning_it: a favore di; per il beneficio di
entries.decision: Canonical invariant free benefactive relator. Former suffix -pro is retired.

entries.meaning_it: a causa di; perché/poiché/siccome (introduce anche una proposizione causale)
entries.decision: Canonical invariant free causal relator, pronounced with canonical hiatus /du.e/. Former suffix -due is retired. Author ratified on 2026-10-24 extension to complete causal clause in both P due Q and due Q, P, distinct from inferential ergo.
Canonical invariant free purposive relator. Former suffix -fin is retired.
Canonical invariant free temporal relator. Former suffix -tem is retired.

entries.meaning_it: nel modo di; alla maniera di
entries.decision: Canonical invariant free manner relator. Former suffix -mod is retired.

Canonical force/manner verb for push. It describes exerting force in a pushing relation and does not by itself entail successful displacement; actual caused motion is expressed by the mov-family valency frame.

entries.source: Latin trahere / tract-; international traction-tractor family
entries.decision: Canonical force/manner verb for pull. It describes traction/pulling and does not by itself entail successful displacement; actual caused motion is expressed by the mov-family valency frame.
Canonical vertical-axis root for high/upper/up. With allative -ad, altad marks upward direction/toward a higher position. It may compound transparently with mov: altmov = ascend/go up.
Canonical vertical-axis root for low/lower/down. With allative -ad, basad marks downward direction/toward a lower position. It may compound transparently with mov: basmov = descend/go down.
Canonical transparent motion compound alt+mov for upward motion/ascending. Equivalent directional paraphrase: mov altad. It is distinct from phase-derived admov, which means begin moving.
Canonical transparent motion compound bas+mov for downward motion/descending. Equivalent directional paraphrase: mov basad. It is distinct from phase-derived demov, which means cease moving.
Canonical root for air. Preserves the classical/international aer- family in canonical Unisermo spelling.

entries.source: Latin planus / planum; international plan-/plane family
entries.decision: Canonical root for plane/flat/level. Used as the second component of transparent compound aerplan.

entries.source: productive compound aer + plan; international aeroplane family
entries.decision: Canonical transparent compound aer+plan for airplane/aeroplane. Preferred over aeroplan; the lexical structure is explicitly aer + plan.

entries.source: Author-confirmed choice, original ChatGPT conversation 2026-08-10 16:11:23 UTC; restored at author's instruction 2026-10-24
entries.decision: Canonize adel as neutral sibling root. This August 10 author-approved choice was omitted from the saved lexicon; explicitly restored by author October 24, replacing obsolete frat.

entries.source: Author-confirmed 2026-08-10 adel + -o masculine sibling formation; restoration 2026-10-24
entries.decision: Canonize adelo = male sibling/brother, derived from neutral adel plus kinship-family ending -o. Replaces retired frat. Not evidence of a universal gender rule across all nouns.

entries.source: Author-confirmed 2026-08-10 adel + -e feminine sibling formation; restoration 2026-10-24
entries.decision: Canonize adele = female sibling/sister, derived from neutral adel plus kinship-family ending -e. Do not generalize this pattern to unconfirmed kinship candidates.
Canonize gen as neutral parent relation, base for geno (father) and gene (mother).
Canonize geno = father, male parent. Sex suffix applies to the immediate parent relation in this confirmed form.
Canonize gene = mother, female parent. Sex suffix applies to the immediate parent relation in this confirmed form.
Canonize adelgen = sibling of a parent. Composition A+B means A relative to B, keeping left and right relation roles distinct.

entries.meaning_it: nonno o nonna (genitore di un genitore, neutro)
entries.source: 2026-08-10 original genealogical NUMjer design, author reaffirmation 2026-10-24
entries.decision: Canonize bisjergen = two successive gen (parent) relations: parent of parent. bisjer counts two relational steps. No claim that bisjergeno/bisjergene have resolved male/female endpoint scope.

entries.meaning_it: figlio o figlia in quanto discendente diretto; prole
entries.meaning_en: offspring; child of a parent (relational, gender-neutral)
entries.source: Direct author ratification, 2026-10-24; prior kinship design discussion
entries.decision: Canonize fil as the inverse one-generation relation to gen: offspring/child of a parent, irrespective of age or sex. It does not mean a young person.

entries.meaning_it: cugino o cugina di primo grado (figlio o figlia di uno zio/zia)
entries.meaning_en: first cousin (offspring of a parent's sibling, gender-neutral)
entries.source: Productive relational composition fil + adel + gen following direct approval of fil, 2026-10-24
entries.decision: Canonical transparent kinship compound filadelgen = fil + (adel + gen), offspring of parent's sibling = first cousin. Components compose as A relative to B and are evaluated from right to left. Not a gender-specific or more distant cousin.

entries.source: Author-requested genealogical path feature, 2026-10-24; compose gene + gene
entries.decision: Canonize genegene = gene + gene: mother of mother; trace relational path from ego right to left. Explicit link sex is part of each parent root, not a floating word-final gender suffix.

entries.source: Author-requested genealogical path feature, 2026-10-24; compose gene + geno
entries.decision: Canonize genegeno = gene + geno: mother of father; traverse rightmost geno (father), then leftmost gene (his mother).

entries.source: Author-requested genealogical path feature, 2026-10-24; compose geno + gene
entries.decision: Canonize genogene = geno + gene: father of mother; traverse rightmost gene (mother), then leftmost geno (her father).

entries.source: Author-requested genealogical path feature, 2026-10-24; compose geno + geno
entries.decision: Canonize genogeno = geno + geno: father of father; both links specify male parent. Not a general label for all grandfathers.

entries.source: Author ratification 2026-10-24; replaces historical mil; internationally recognizable mila/mille
entries.decision: Ratify mila as the sole current numerical power 1000; explicitly retire historical mil as noncanonical. Group coefficient 1..999 precedes mila, omitting uno for coefficient 1. Composites remain fused.

entries.source: Author ratification 2026-10-24; international mega- power prefix
entries.decision: Ratify mega as the numerical power 1000000, with a fused 1..999 coefficient before it, omitting uno for multiplier 1 and omitting zero groups.

entries.source: Author ratification 2026-10-24; international giga- power prefix
entries.decision: Ratify giga as the numerical power 1000000000 (short-scale billion, Italian miliardo), with a fused 1..999 group coefficient, not as an abbreviation gig.

entries.meaning_it: buono; valutazione positiva generale dipendente dal contesto
entries.source: Already attested in language/copula.md and language/adjectives.md; author clarification 2026-10-24
entries.decision: General goodness only: not lexical synonym of aesthetic bel, moral prob or functional apt.
Restrict to the aesthetic domain, including aesthetic judgment of sounds and experiences; not a general synonym for bon.

entries.meaning_it: moralmente buono; retto; di integrità morale
entries.decision: Denotes positive moral character or conduct, not generic goodness, proof/probability or merely adherence to a moral code.

entries.meaning_it: etico; relativo all'etica; conforme a principi etici
entries.meaning_en: ethical; pertaining to ethics or aligned with ethical principles
entries.source: Author ratification 2026-10-24; Greek ethikos via international ethical vocabulary
entries.decision: Distinguish from prob: ethical conformity is not necessarily a global evaluation of a person's moral goodness.
Descriptive domain adjective, not necessarily positive: moral actions or moral issues are not by definition good.

entries.meaning_it: nobile; di nobiltà sociale o nobiltà d'animo secondo contesto
entries.meaning_en: noble; socially noble or noble in character depending on context
entries.decision: Social and figurative senses should be distinguished contextually; nobl is not a generic equivalent of prob.
A specific moral dimension (justice/fairness), not all moral goodness.

entries.meaning_it: adatto; idoneo a una funzione o uno scopo
entries.meaning_en: apt; fit or suitable for a purpose
entries.source: Author selection in 2026-10-24 discussion preceding this ratification; record as provisional rather than author-ratified
entries.decision: Functional fitness only; separate from efficiency, effectiveness, and general quality.

entries.meaning_it: opposto semantico di una qualita; polo contrario, non semplice negazione
entries.meaning_en: lexical antonym / semantic opposite of a quality, not simple negation
entries.decision: Ratify fused ne- for opposite semantic poles of opposable qualities; deprecate historical attached no-. Keep free no for logical predicate negation and anti- for active opposition. Examples bel/nebel versus no bel.

entries.meaning_it: legale; conforme al diritto positivo applicabile
entries.meaning_en: legal; conforming to applicable positive law
entries.decision: Positive-law domain; distinct from just and fas.

entries.meaning_it: lecito secondo la norma sacra o religiosa
entries.meaning_en: permitted under a sacred or religious normative order
entries.decision: Sacred norm rather than positive law or generic morality.

entries.meaning_it: illegale; contrario al diritto positivo applicabile
entries.decision: Contrary to legal, not merely negated no legal.
Contrary to sacred permissibility, not merely negated no fas.

entries.meaning_it: medio; intermedio; collocato nella parte centrale di una scala
entries.meaning_en: middle; intermediate; central position on a scale
entries.decision: Descriptive midpoint or intermediate degree, not intrinsically mediocre or negative.

entries.meaning_it: di qualita media; ordinario; senza particolare pregio
entries.decision: Approved lexical compound medi+bon. Not intrinsically derogatory; may convey mediocre when context implies modest evaluation. Its compounding pattern must be checked against general compound morphology before treating it as productive.

entries.source: Author ratification 2026-10-24: absolute intensity scale A
entries.decision: Free preverbal/preadjectival degree modifier; invariant; modifies gradable predicate, not comparison set. Distinct from relative operators major/minor/masim/minim.

entries.source: Author ratification 2026-10-24: absolute intensity scale A
entries.decision: Free preverbal/preadjectival degree modifier; invariant; modifies gradable predicate, not comparison set. Distinct from relative operators major/minor/masim/minim.

entries.decision: Free preverbal/preadjectival degree modifier; invariant; modifies gradable predicate, not comparison set. Distinct from relative operators major/minor/masim/minim.

entries.source: Author ratification 2026-10-24: absolute intensity scale A
entries.decision: Free preverbal/preadjectival degree modifier; invariant; modifies gradable predicate, not comparison set. Distinct from relative operators major/minor/masim/minim.

entries.meaning_it: abbastanza; piuttosto; grado moderatamente elevato, senza implicare sufficienza
entries.decision: Analytic degree modifier preceding a gradable quality; not threshold sufficiency.

entries.meaning_it: sufficientemente; quanto basta rispetto a uno scopo o una soglia
entries.meaning_en: sufficiently; enough relative to a purpose or threshold
entries.decision: Analytic sufficiency operator: reaches contextual requirement; not a fixed degree or synonym of mult.

entries.source: Explicit author ratification 2026-10-24, Latin si adapted to distinguish si=yes
entries.decision: Ratify standalone se as IF, distinct from confirmed si YES and no NO/NOT. No automatic ratification of then/tum, ergo, nisi, sin, sed or other connective forms.

entries.source: Explicit author ratification 2026-10-24; Italian allora and French alors
entries.decision: Use alor for THEN in condition-consequence constructions, distinct from ergo inferential THEREFORE. Not obligatory by this lexical ratification; its precise omission rules and nested scopes await detailed conditional syntax.

entries.source: Explicit author ratification 2026-10-24; Italian ma, French mais and Portuguese mas
entries.decision: Use standalone ma as ordinary adversative BUT, distinct from simple additive e. Concessive subordinate connectors remain open.
Use ergo to introduce inferential conclusions, distinct from conditional-correlative alor and ordinary adversative ma.

entries.meaning_it: sebbene, benché, nonostante il fatto che
entries.decision: Concessive conjunction allowing etsi P, Q and Q etsi P. Factual or contextually accepted P contrasted with Q; hypothetical even-if semantics remain unresolved.

entries.meaning_it: infatti; introduce una giustificazione o evidenza per un'affermazione
entries.meaning_en: for/indeed; introduces an evidential or argumentative reason supporting an assertion
entries.decision: P nam Q indicates that the speaker presents Q as support for asserting P, without claiming that Q caused P or that Q proves P. Distinct from factual causal due and inference-first ergo.

entries.source: Explicit author ratification 2026-10-24; compound etsi + se
entries.decision: Canonical fused invariant compound etsi+se = hypothetical EVEN IF. Unlike factual concessive etsi, this construction does not assert the truth or falsity of P. Both etsise P, Q and Q etsise P are accepted. Not a general license for arbitrary connective fusion.

entries.meaning_it: eksetto, tranne, salvo; operatore generale di esclusione
entries.source: Explicit author ratification 2026-10-24; international except/exception family, distinct from Latin ekse ('behold')
entries.decision: Free invariant ekse marks nominal/general exclusion or exception. Its nominal scope and distribution await further parser formalization. Not equivalent to ordinary conjunction ma.

entries.meaning_it: a meno che, salvo che; eksezione condizionale
entries.source: Explicit author ratification 2026-10-24; fused ekse + se
entries.decision: Canonical single-word compound ekse+se marks conditional exception (UNLESS). Both eksese P, Q and Q eksese P are permitted. Distinct from se no P, Q, which expresses only a negative condition and need not imply an exception to an expectation or rule. Not blanket permission to fuse arbitrary connective forms.
e as a free-standing conjunction AND; distinct from bound progressive aspect -e.
o as a free-standing conjunction OR; distinct from bound perfect/completive aspect -o. Inclusive vs exclusive scope is not yet specified.
Part-whole relationship; genitive can identify the whole.
Thinking does not entail understanding.
Understanding differs from thinking and knowing.
